# Ava Ivy — Directory (llms.txt)

> Transparent, read-only directory browser for the Ava home tree.
> Agents: prefer the JSON APIs and path-based file URLs below. Do not rely on the client-rendered HTML page.

## Root

Live root is reported by the status endpoint (usually `/home/ava-core` or `/home/ava-ivy`).

- Status: https://directory.avaivy.cloud/api/directory/status
- UI: https://directory.avaivy.cloud/

## List directories (JSON)

```
GET https://directory.avaivy.cloud/api/directory/list?path=<rel>&recursive=0
```

- `path` — relative to the directory root (empty = root)
- `recursive` — `0` or `1`
- Secrets, credentials, and `.env*` are excluded from listings
- Sensitive paths appear with `"sensitive": true` but content is never served

Example:
https://directory.avaivy.cloud/api/directory/list?path=.ollama&recursive=0
https://directory.avaivy.cloud/api/directory/list?path=operations&recursive=0

## Read a non-sensitive file (preferred for agents)

### Path-based raw file URL (no JS required)

```
https://directory.avaivy.cloud/ava-ivy/file/<relative/path/to/file>
```

Examples:
- https://directory.avaivy.cloud/ava-ivy/file/README.md
- https://directory.avaivy.cloud/ava-ivy/file/operations/broadcast.py
- https://directory.avaivy.cloud/ava-ivy/file/web/sites/avaivy.cloud/directory/directory.js

### JSON wrapper (metadata + content)

```
GET https://directory.avaivy.cloud/api/directory/file?path=<rel>&format=json
```

Returns `{ ok, status, meta, content, content_type }`.

## Browser UI deep links (path = real location)

The address bar mirrors the filesystem under the reported root:

- https://directory.avaivy.cloud/home/ava-core
- https://directory.avaivy.cloud/home/ava-core/.ollama
- https://directory.avaivy.cloud/home/ava-core/operations
- https://directory.avaivy.cloud/home/ava-core/web/sites/avaivy.cloud

Also accepted: `?path=<rel>` on `/` or `/directory`.

## Safety rules (enforced server-side)

- Hidden entirely: credential-like names, `.env*`, `.ssh`, tunnel tokens, etc.
- Listed but content blocked: sensitive session/auth-related paths
- Binary / non-text: short notice returned instead of body
- Text previews capped (server default ~2 MiB)

## How an agent should explore

1. `GET /api/directory/status` → learn `root`
2. `GET /api/directory/list?path=&recursive=0` → top-level tree
3. Descend with `path=<rel>`
4. For each readable file, fetch `/ava-ivy/file/<rel>` or the JSON file API
5. Never request secrets; they will 404/403 by design

## Related

- Ava energy dashboard (same origin host): https://avaivy.cloud/
- Systems: https://avaivy.cloud/system/
